notes: Fewer, narrower Google permissions: HouseRunner now only asks for read-only Gmail (for Parcels) plus “send email as you” (for emailing you your links), instead of Google’s all-in-one “read, compose, send and permanently delete all your email”. And it can only see its own Sheet, not all your spreadsheets. Existing Sheets carry on working; to switch one over, replace its appsscript.json (see help).

Setting up in your Sheet: ▶ HouseRunner – SETUP now opens a window that shows each step as it happens – making the tabs, publishing, checking it answers – and only says Published ✅ once your dashboard really answers. Choosing SETUP again never makes a second copy of the published dashboard.

Moving to a different Google account no longer shares a copy of your Sheet: the new dashboard collects everything straight from the old one, with a one-off link that stops working once the move is done.
Privacy notice updated for the narrower permissions – you’ll be asked to accept it once more.
